title: Regulatory deadline rule set
description: Framework-neutral deadline rules. Consumed by the backend (Python) and the landing site (TypeScript). Semantics are specified in rules/README.md.

rule_set_version.description: Version of this rule set. Changing any rule requires a new version; stored deadlines keep the version they were computed with.

event_type.description: Legal qualification of the event under one regime.

anchor.description: Instant the offset is counted from. aware_at: when the organisation became aware of the event. fix_available_at: when the first corrective or mitigating measure was made available (CRA wording). notification_submitted_at: when the notification stage was actually submitted. An unknown anchor yields a 'waiting' state, never a date.

offset.description: Exactly one unit. hours: exact elapsed hours on the UTC timeline. months: calendar months on the local wall clock of the reporting timezone, clamped to the last day of the target month (see rules/README.md).

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the rule set. Stored on every computed deadline.

source_url.description: Official source of the legal text.

verified_at.description: Date the rule was checked against the official legal text; null until then.

notes.description: Legal basis and caveats. Must contain TODO(verify) while verified_at is null.
